title: Rates and publishing
text: The prices a broker is quoted, how they are published and what the broker receives.

title: Rates: the price per day for each car group, by season and by rental length.
text: Example: Economy (EDAR) 40 USD a day for 1–2 days, 35 for 3–6 days, 30 from 7 days.

title: “Add period” adds a season; “Excel” downloads the grid to edit and upload again.
text: Changes stay a draft until you click “Review & publish”.

title: Publish history: every published version, who published it and when.
text: A wrong change can be rolled back to an earlier version in one step.

title: XML feed: the rate sheet exactly as the broker receives it, ready to copy or download.
text: Useful when a broker asks “which prices did you send us?”.
